review.brief: Review change RM50-gateway-add-travel-progress-subsection (roadmap RM50 tier 2, module gateway). Read the diff of commits ba4f058, dc22a17, 109c7c1 against their parent -- not the whole module. Validate: (1) module-boundary compliance -- no HTML outside internal/gateway, no cross-module DB read, internal/analytics untouched; (2) every doc-pack convention -- ai/go-conventions.md, ai/htmx-conventions.md, internal/gateway/AGENTS.md, including the ui/ kit rule that pages never hand-write component markup; (3) bilingual i18n -- all six new keys have ES and EN non-empty and every new string goes through i18n.T; (4) semantic theme tokens only, no raw colour, no inline DaisyUI component class (RD6); (5) spec and tasks coverage -- every requirement in specs/gateway/spec.md is actually implemented, and the MODIFIED requirement's rewrite kept its real contract (badges, not a status tile) while dropping only the now-false grid-shape claim; (6) the implementation matches design.md D1-D9 -- a mismatch with a user-confirmed decision is a blocker finding; (7) RD-fixed -- the two Travel Progress trend icons are FIXED (up for distance, down for battery used), never delta-driven; (8) nil handling -- a nil DistanceTraveledKmCalc or ConsumedPct renders the dash placeholder, never a fabricated 0; (9) tier scope -- the Tire pressure subsection renders NOTHING here, only a comment marking where tier 4 inserts it; (10) the Performance-Profile -- this is a read path; confirm it adds no new query, no new port method and no per-request computation; (11) docs track structural change -- AGENTS.md and the two kkpa/context KB guides were corrected in the same change, and nothing under openspec/changes/archive/ was edited; (12) anti-gaming -- no acceptance criterion was weakened or deleted, no status was self-approved, and tasks.md checkboxes match what the diff actually does. TEST SIGNALS: go build, go vet, gofmt, make ui-guard and make i18n-guard were run by the ASSISTANT and pass. The test SUITE was run by the OWNER, who reported it passing; the owner also confirmed the rendered page by eye. You must NOT run the suite. Judge test quality by READING the tests, not by running them. Note RD8 deliberately forbids cosmetic tests -- markup, CSS classes, ARIA and element placement are NOT to be tested; do not raise missing layout tests as a finding. Known and accepted, not findings: gofmt flags internal/gateway/vehicle_image_test.go, which is pre-existing and untouched by this change.
